name: Chervil

schedule.notes: Bolts hot — succession every 3 weeks until heat hits.
Snip outer fronds at the base. Cut hard before flowering for a second flush.

harvest.cues: Fronds 6+ in, bright green, lacy. Before flower stalk appears.
harvest.storageNotes: Most delicate of the herbs — fresh only. Add at the end of cooking. Wraps in damp paper towel, fridge 3 days max.

varieties.name: Vertissimo
varieties.notes: Slow to bolt, curly leaves. Best for spring sowings.

notes: Delicate anise-parsley flavor. Indispensable in French fines herbes (with parsley, chives, tarragon). Loves shade — perfect under taller spring crops.
